description: This file contains system-on-chip (SoC) initialization code for an openisa_rv32m1 platform, including clock configuration, interrupt handling, and hardware setup.

methods.name: soc_interrupt_init
methods.description: Initializes SoC-level interrupts, clears pending interrupts, and sets up the interrupt multiplexer if enabled.

methods.name: arch_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables a specific IRQ, handling multi-level interrupts if configured.

methods.name: arch_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables a specific IRQ, handling multi-level interrupts if configured.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ is enabled.

methods.name: sys_arch_reboot
methods.description: Triggers a system reboot by setting the SYSRSTREQST mask.

methods.name: rv32m1_switch_sys_clk
methods.description: Switches system clock configuration in run mode, waiting until the change takes effect.

methods.name: rv32m1_switch_to_sirc
methods.description: Initializes and switches system clock source to SIRC.

methods.name: rv32m1_setup_peripheral_clocks
methods.description: Configures peripheral clocks for TPM modules.

methods.name: soc_rv32m1_init
methods.description: Performs hardware initialization including clock setup and LPFLL initialization.
